changeSet.sql: UPDATE bytedesk_team_member m SET allowed_login_platforms = CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bytedesk_core_user u WHERE u.id = m.user_id AND u.is_super = TRUE ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bytedesk_core_user_roles cur INNER JOIN bytedesk_core_role r ON r.id = cur.role_id WHERE cur.user_id = m.user_id AND r.uuid IN ('df_role_admin_uid', 'df_role_super_uid') ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bytedesk_core_user_org_role uor INNER JOIN bytedesk_core_organization o ON o.id = uor.organization_id INNER JOIN bytedesk_core_user_org_role_roles uorr ON uorr.user_org_role_id = uor.id INNER JOIN bytedesk_core_role r2 ON r2.id = uorr.role_id WHERE uor.user_id = m.user_id AND o.uuid = m.org_uid AND r2.uuid IN ('df_role_admin_uid', 'df_role_super_uid') ) THEN 'admin,desktop,notebase,workflow,call,callAdmin' ELSE 'desktop' END WHERE allowed_login_platforms IS NULL OR allowed_login_platforms = '';
